errors.text: The proposed (MoWVNbTa)S2 transition-metal dichalcogenide is fundamentally different from the target MgAlTiVFeCo metallic BCC alloy and is not a reconstruction of its ball-milled initial state.
The response combines a 2H layered dichalcogenide phase with a B2-ordered metallic matrix without evidence that these structurally incompatible descriptions coexist in this material.
No cited evidence establishes that (MoWVNbTa)S2 remains compositionally or phase stable during SPS at 1000 °C; sulfur loss, decomposition, and secondary sulfide formation are not controlled.
The proposed lattice-distortion and Nb2O5/Ta2O5 mechanisms do not reproduce the target oxide-barrier mechanism involving AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.

The predicted hardness, density, oxidation behavior, and corrosion behavior are extrapolated from unrelated FeCoCrNi-WC composites, electrocatalytic sulfides, or general HEA literature rather than measured evidence for the proposed bulk material.
The processing boundaries omit the target 800–1000 °C sintering window and magnesium-volatilization upper limit, while introducing precursor-decomposition constraints irrelevant to the target system.
